title: Two Microservices
description: Run two microservices (user and product) on different ports and coordinate them.

steps.title: User service
steps.description: Create Service A (user service) on port 3001 with a GET /users endpoint returning a list of users.
hints: Use app.get('/users', handler) to respond with user data
Return an array of user objects with id and name fields

steps.title: Product service
steps.description: Create Service B (product service) on port 3002 with a GET /products endpoint returning product data.
hints: Create a separate Express app or file for product service
Use app.get('/products', handler) returning products array

steps.title: Both services running
steps.description: Ensure both services run simultaneously on different ports. Each should respond with 200 on its endpoints.
hints: Start both services in separate processes or threads
Service A on port 3001, Service B on port 3002
Use separate terminals or process spawn to run both

steps.title: Health checks
steps.description: Add a /health endpoint to each service that returns 200 with a status object.
hints: Add app.get('/health', handler) to each service
Return { status: 'ok' } from each health endpoint
Both services should respond 200 on their /health routes
